newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shrs close down, investors await Q3 results.
newsitem.headline: Lima shrs close down, investors await Q3 results.

text.p: Shares on the Lima stock exchange closed down Wednesday in apathetic trade as investors remained cautious ahead of this week's release of companies' third quarter financial results, brokers said.
They added the reluctance to enter the market would likely continue for the rest of the week as investors needed time to study the results before deciding which stocks to buy.
Wednesday, the General Index .IGRA fell 0.86 percent to 1,540.82 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index dropped 0.14 percent to 2,095.61 points, according to preliminary stock figures.

"It is difficult to pick out any trend in the current conditions," said Roberto Atking of local brokerage Sociedad Surinvest. "It seems New York is galvanizing the interest of investors, who do not want to enter (the Lima market) until they have seen companies' financial results."
In a total of 1,653 trades, 37 stocks were stable, 34 fell, and 20 rose in weak volume of 23.6 million ($9.2 million).
Accounting for 29 percent of the market's volume, benchmark Telefonica del Peru was the most heavily traded stock as it fell 0.35 percent to 5.63 soles.
Among other leaders, Backus Johnston - the country's largest brewery - resisted the market's general undertow and rose 0.78 percent to 2.58 with 11 percent of total volume.
